mapper.sql: BALANCE_ID, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NAME, ACCOUNTING_PERIOD, BEGINNING_BALANCE, PERIOD_DEBIT_AMOUNT, PERIOD_CREDIT_AMOUNT, ENDING_BALANCE, BALANCE_DIRECTION, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, CREATED_TIME, UPDATED_TIME
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO TBL_SUBJECT_BALANCE t USING ( SELECT #{subjectId} as SUBJECT_ID, #{subjectCode} as SUBJECT_CODE, #{accountingPeriod} as ACCOUNTING_PERIOD, #{bookId} as BOOK_ID, #{tenantId} as TENANT_ID FROM DUAL ) s ON (t.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE AND t.ACCOUNTING_PERIOD = s.ACCOUNTING_PERIOD AND t.BOOK_ID = s.BOOK_ID AND t.TENANT_ID = s.TENANT_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.SUBJECT_NAME = #{subjectName}, t.BEGINNING_BALANCE = #{beginningBalance}, t.PERIOD_DEBIT_AMOUNT = #{periodDebitAmount}, t.PERIOD_CREDIT_AMOUNT = #{periodCreditAmount}, t.ENDING_BALANCE = #{endingBalance}, t.BALANCE_DIRECTION = #{balanceDirection}, t.UPDATED_TIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NAME, ACCOUNTING_PERIOD, BEGINNING_BALANCE, PERIOD_DEBIT_AMOUNT, PERIOD_CREDIT_AMOUNT, ENDING_BALANCE, BALANCE_DIRECTION, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, CREATED_TIME ) VALUES ( #{subjectId}, #{subjectCode}, #{subjectName}, #{accountingPeriod}, #{beginningBalance}, #{periodDebitAmount}, #{periodCreditAmount}, #{endingBalance}, #{balanceDirection}, #{bookId}, #{tenantId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )

insert.foreach: MERGE INTO TBL_SUBJECT_BALANCE t USING ( SELECT #{balance.subjectId} as SUBJECT_ID, #{balance.subjectCode} as SUBJECT_CODE, #{balance.accountingPeriod} as ACCOUNTING_PERIOD, #{balance.bookId} as BOOK_ID, #{balance.tenantId} as TENANT_ID FROM DUAL ) s ON (t.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE AND t.ACCOUNTING_PERIOD = s.ACCOUNTING_PERIOD AND t.BOOK_ID = s.BOOK_ID AND t.TENANT_ID = s.TENANT_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.SUBJECT_NAME = #{balance.subjectName}, t.BEGINNING_BALANCE = #{balance.beginningBalance}, t.PERIOD_DEBIT_AMOUNT = #{balance.periodDebitAmount}, t.PERIOD_CREDIT_AMOUNT = #{balance.periodCreditAmount}, t.ENDING_BALANCE = #{balance.endingBalance}, t.BALANCE_DIRECTION = #{balance.balanceDirection}, t.UPDATED_TIME = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NAME, ACCOUNTING_PERIOD, BEGINNING_BALANCE, PERIOD_DEBIT_AMOUNT, PERIOD_CREDIT_AMOUNT, ENDING_BALANCE, BALANCE_DIRECTION, BOOK_ID, TENANT_ID, CREATED_TIME ) VALUES ( #{balance.subjectId}, #{balance.subjectCode}, #{balance.subjectName}, #{balance.accountingPeriod}, #{balance.beginningBalance}, #{balance.periodDebitAmount}, #{balance.periodCreditAmount}, #{balance.endingBalance}, #{balance.balanceDirection}, #{balance.bookId}, #{balance.tenantId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
